source: scratch Python script: logging.Formatter.converter = time.gmtime (UTC); logging.basicConfig(stream=sys.stdout, level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(name)s: %(message)s"); logger "queue.worker"; for i in 1 to 420 with job = 4000 + i: i in 175, 190, 205, 220, 235, 250 logs error "job %d failed: upstream returned 503 after 3 retries" % job; i in 180, 230 logs warning "job %d slow: 2.4 s over budget" % job; every other i logs info "job %d done in %d ms, %d bytes written" % (job, 20 + i % 37, 1024 + 13 * i), run by capture-shaping.sh in /repo
